svg.text: LAPI Engine: analyzes logs, generates decisions
1. Stop: sonarr, radarr, prowlarr, bazarr, profilarr
2. Run: docker compose up rustic (backup to B2)
Containers communicate via internal DNS name
Services protected by Caddy authentication (reverse proxy + auth portal)
Volume Mounts — Which folder is in which container?
